title: look.set on Joomla T4 writes the template's own local/css/custom.css (never a plugin or lightbox icon sheet loaded after the winner) and treats a header menu link as site-wide
steps: S1: look.set a colour on a T4 page whose winning rule sits in T4's bundle and whose last loaded template-folder sheet is templates/ja_boxing/js/html5lightbox/icons/css/fontello.css (saigon-iron-boxing on dev, 25/10/2026).
S2: look.set a header menu link colour on the same T4 layout, where T4 wraps the header section inside <main>.
expect: S1: the rule lands in templates/ja_boxing/local/css/custom.css (created when missing, removed by its undo), made more specific than the winner; fontello.css is untouched.
S2: describeTarget reports the link as site chrome; one site-wide rule with no page class, and the every-page question is asked before the write.
evidence: Dev turns on 25/10/2026: 4 of 6 look edits went into fontello.css or got a home-page-only scope, and the agent then rewrote them by hand in local/css/custom.css (~20 to 30 s per turn)
fence: Unit tests over the tool's public entry (look.set with a fake site io) and describeTarget on the T4 page fixture

tests: 🔒 Joomla T4: a look goes into the template’s local/css/custom.css
🔒 Joomla T4: a template that ships css/custom.css
🔒 Joomla T4: a header menu link is the same on every page
🔒 describeTarget (look.set): T4 puts its header inside <main>
